name: Tsumugi
source:
The loli that is actually the same age as Kai and others. Dislikes studying, naps at noon, and can be said to be the “mansion idiot”, the only trait deferring her from a typical child is her ability to sew. Doesn’t get along with [url=/c683]Chisha[/url], but clings to [url=/c682]Michiru[/url] more than anyone else. 

[Edited and taken from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
